title: C-NGP shared scene field plus Mirror scene code
blocker: Faithful C-NGP baseline requires CUDA, tinycudann, and its compiled CUDA extension; baseline checkpoints and scene assets are absent.
hypothesis: A compact scene-specific View coordinate on the shared C-NGP physical field can recover held-out scene radiance quality and retention at lower actual serialized bytes than native scene conditioning plus replay state.
physical_object: One continually trained multi-scene C-NGP field and renderer
mirror_coordinate: Scene-specific View coordinate m applied to the shared field representation
logical_multiplicity: Multiple logical radiance fields from one shared physical field
controls_required: Native C-NGP scene pseudo-label plus generative replay
Ordinary scene embedding/FiLM with matched bytes
Independent per-scene field upper control when feasible
success_gate: Not frozen; must be set against the native C-NGP scene-conditioning control before any fresh evaluation.
failure_gate: Not frozen; no experiment has been run.
boundaries: No C-NGP/NeRF result is established by this feasibility review.
Do not substitute a synthetic 2D field and call it MA-891 completion.
